name: Akatsuki no Amaneka to Aoi Kyojin ~Pashiate Bunmei Kenkyuukai Koubouki~
original_name: 暁のアマネカと蒼い巨神 ーパシアテ文明研究会興亡記ー
source:
Amaneka is a student of the Empire Junior Academy. Everyone in the country is excited because the 1st International Exhibition will be held there soon. Students of the Empire Junior Academy are excited as well. Only one club can take part in it, so students are now busy preparing for it. Amaneka and her friends also set out on an adventure for a secret treasure....

translation:
阿玛奈卡是帝国初等学院的学生。第一届国际博览会即将在国内举办，举国上下都为此振奋，帝国初等学院的学生也不例外。只有一个社团能够参加博览会，因此学生们正忙于准备。阿玛奈卡与朋友们也为了寻找秘宝，踏上冒险之旅……
